applies_why: The judge text evaluates whether a challenger link is broken with cited verses and does not count a verse on a cited-in line as an unanswered witness.
rule_words: A verse on a side's 'cited in' line counts as an unanswered witness only when the judge quotes the sentence of the earlier round that pressed it against that link or a listed premise and names that round; a verse cited there but not pressed against the link does not count.
room: the phrase 'counts as an unanswered witness' — I weighed whether any verse citation triggers the rule versus only a verse counted as an unanswered witness; the text does not present one as an unanswered witness.
why: Because the rule is limited to counting a verse as an unanswered witness, and this text only evaluates a link as broken, it does not breach K-G4.
